platform.meta.title: Robot management platform: monitoring, fleet, KPIs, Open API | Professional Robotics
platform.meta.description: Our own platform for managing robots of any type and brand: monitoring, fleet, quality and KPIs, AI analytics, Open API. Built in Russia, data stays here.
platform.hero.title: Professional Robotics Platform
platform.hero.lead: One platform to manage your robots, equipment and site operations.
platform.hero.text: Deploying a robot is half the job. After that you need to manage it, see what was done and where, control quality and service it on time. The platform brings it all into one window: fleet, tasks, quality, analytics and service. In effect, it is an operating system for robotic operations.
platform.ops.label: Example operator console: one operator and 24 robots of five types on one screen
platform.idea.title: We manage results and quality, not just robots.
platform.idea.lead: A robot is a tool. It creates value when a system stands behind it: one that assigns tasks, tracks execution, catches deviations and gives an objective picture of operations.
platform.idea.one.caption: One operator oversees dozens of devices through the platform, with no extra headcount.
platform.problems.title: Sound familiar? The platform is built for it.
platform.problems.staff.title: Staffing
platform.problems.staff.text: Labor shortages, high turnover, rising labor costs and dependence on shifts.
platform.problems.opaque.title: No visibility
platform.problems.opaque.text: The site doesn’t know where work was done, what was missed, how long it took or whether it followed the standard.
platform.problems.quality.title: Inconsistent quality
platform.problems.quality.text: Results change from shift to shift and depend on the individual.
platform.problems.costs.title: High costs
platform.problems.costs.text: Wasted consumables, inefficient equipment, expensive quality control.
platform.problems.disturb.title: Work gets in the way
platform.problems.disturb.text: Noise and blocked aisles during business hours, discomfort for visitors.
platform.capabilities.title: What the platform does.
platform.capabilities.lead: Eleven features in one window. Pick any one and see how it looks in the interface.
platform.cap.center.title: Single control center
platform.cap.center.text: One panel for all your sites: map, device status, tasks, alerts and analytics. The whole fleet is visible in real time and managed from one place.
platform.cap.fleet.title: Fleet management
platform.cap.fleet.text: Hundreds of devices under control: grouping by site and status, bulk commands, remote setup and updates, schedule and workflow management.
platform.cap.monitoring.title: Round-the-clock monitoring
platform.cap.monitoring.text: Live telemetry and an operations map, status and error tracking, uptime, operation history and failure alerts.
platform.cap.maps.title: Digital maps and navigation
platform.cap.maps.text: A site map with work zones, routes and no-go zones. Equipment is tracked on the map in real time, and zones are edited online and synced from the cloud.
platform.cap.dispatch.title: Task assignment and coordination
platform.cap.dispatch.text: The platform assigns tasks between devices, builds the schedule and coordinates several robots on one site, so they stay out of each other’s way and cover the area without gaps.
platform.cap.remote.title: Remote control
platform.cap.remote.text: Start and stop tasks, run remote diagnostics and support, trigger an emergency stop from anywhere. The operator doesn’t need to be on site.
platform.cap.analytics.title: AI analytics and predictive maintenance
platform.cap.analytics.text: Analysis of equipment utilization, route efficiency and site performance, heat maps and recurring errors. The system flags maintenance needs ahead of time: before a breakdown, not after.
platform.cap.agents.title: In-house AI agents
platform.cap.agents.text: Our own intelligent agents analyze operations in real time, find problem areas, flag deviations and recommend how to optimize work and cut costs.
platform.cap.api.title: Integrations
platform.cap.api.text: Connects to building systems (BMS), IoT and smart-building platforms, security systems, and your ERP and facility platforms. The platform fits into your infrastructure instead of replacing it.
platform.cap.sla.title: SLA and service
platform.cap.sla.text: Service is built into the platform: stability monitoring, incident management, remote support, predictive maintenance. The goal is minimal downtime.
platform.cap.custom.title: Custom software for you
platform.cap.custom.text: If the manufacturer lacks a feature, we build it. New workflows, integrations and interfaces are built on the platform, so you don’t wait for a vendor update.
platform.ui.analytics.predText: Wear above normal. Fix before failure.
platform.ui.agents.found: Robots queue up at the elevators
platform.ui.agents.deviation: Zone B was not done on schedule
platform.ui.agents.advice: Move deliveries to another time to free up the elevators
platform.ui.sla.note: Response time is fixed in the SLA
platform.trust.title: A Russian platform. Your data stays in Russia.
platform.trust.main.title: Data in Russia
platform.trust.main.text: Data is stored in cloud infrastructure located in Russia. For healthcare and government sites, keeping data in Russia often decides the choice.
platform.trust.dev.title: In-house development
platform.trust.dev.text: Fully Russian-developed software aimed at corporate customers. Not a vendor license.
platform.trust.secure.title: Enterprise-grade security
platform.trust.secure.text: Secure communication channels, redundancy, access control.
platform.results.title: A platform built for results.
platform.results.lead: The scale of savings depends on site type and area. The calculator shows it in a couple of minutes.
platform.results.one.title: One operator, dozens of robots
platform.results.one.text: Fewer people on oversight, less dependence on staffing.
platform.results.costs.title: Lower operating costs
platform.results.costs.text: Measured use of consumables and efficient equipment operation.
platform.results.quality.title: Consistent quality
platform.results.quality.text: Every operation follows the set workflow, with no human factor.
platform.results.clarity.title: Transparency
platform.results.clarity.text: Objective reports and KPIs, contractor oversight instead of “looks done”.
platform.results.uptime.title: More uptime
platform.objects.title: Which sites it’s for.
platform.objects.lead: The platform is designed for commercial real estate and public venues.
platform.objects.office.title: Office buildings
platform.objects.office.text: Cleaning outside business hours, consistent quality, transparent contractor oversight and less dependence on staff.
platform.objects.clinic.title: Clinics and healthcare facilities
platform.objects.clinic.text: Standardized cleaning to protocol, tracking of treated zones, a digital operation history and predictable sanitary quality.
platform.objects.retail.title: Retail and public venues
platform.objects.retail.text: Constant cleanliness across large areas, round-the-clock operation and minimal impact on visitors.
